description: Use this when the user wants Deepnia to make an image: gets its exact price in Deepnia credits before anything is created. Nothing is charged. Reference images keep the exact product/person: give the product photo here. Show the price to the user; once they accept, call create_image with the quote_id and credits it returns: that call makes the image (a quote alone creates nothing).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio, for example 1:1, 16:9 or 9:16. With pictures: their own shape when the model allows it. Default: the model's default; see list_creation_options.

count.description: Images to make in this creation, each one charged. Default and limits: settings.count in list_creation_options.

model.description: Image model id from list_creation_options. Default: Deepnia's default.

prompt.description: What to create, in the user's words.

reference_images.description: Reference images keep the exact product/person: give the product photo here. The image is made from them (the product in a new scene, a poster with it). Each is { creation_id } or { url }; how many each model takes: max_reference_images in list_creation_options.

creation_id.description: The id of a finished image made here with create_image (get_creation, list_my_creations).

url.description: A public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture, up to 10 MB.

resolution.description: Resolution, for example 1K or 2K. Default: the model's default; see list_creation_options.

name: quote_image
title: Price an image
